hooks.text: 病毒负荷会随机诱发增益或减益突变
hooks.excerpt: During a run, your mercs are exposed to the virus that takes its toll on the body. A bigger viral load undermines a merc's physical state and increases their chances of developing a mutation that could be beneficial or detrimental. Experiment to create the most viable fighter!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 尸潮压境时可提前呼叫直升机撤离保命
hooks.excerpt: If you're about to be overwhelmed by the zombies’ onslaught, run for your life! Evac is always an option — wrap your mission up early and live to fight another day. Just make it to the copter!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 经营幸存者营地，训练替补佣兵并升级武器护甲
hooks.excerpt: Develop your survivor camp to unlock buffs. Upgrade merc skills in the Training Hall, recruit new mercs at the Mercenary Base, and upgrade your weapons and armor in the workshop.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
